observations.claim: The Monday margin pack takes a full day every week, hand-built by joining TMS and ledger exports whose references do not match cleanly (self reported).
observations.quote: The margin pack is a full day, every week, most of it mine or Maya's.

scale.held_by: the finance lead and deputy personally

observations.claim: About one margin pack in four contains an error, discovered only when a number is challenged (self reported).
observations.quote: about one week in four something's wrong in it

observations.claim: Reconciliation takes about 6 hours a week because the same shipment exists in three places and they drift (self reported).
observations.quote: Reconciliation generally is about 6 hours a week on top of that.

observations.claim: There is no single home for the company's own operating data: the TMS holds the operational truth, the ledger the financial truth, and nothing sits over both.
observations.quote: Loadstone knows the operational truth, Ledgerline knows the financial truth, and nothing sits over both.

observations.claim: The deputy finance lead builds assistant-generated margin views from hand-exported CSVs, stale on creation; live reachable feeds are the stated want.
observations.quote: it's working off a CSV I export by hand, so it's stale the moment I make it
observations.stated_dependencies: If those were reachable, half the Monday pack builds itself.

observations.claim: The finance lead requires controls before anything reads the ledger directly.
observations.quote: I'd want some controls before anything reads the ledger directly.

observations.claim: Month end is two to three days of chasing desks to confirm jobs are closed, the same every month (self reported).
observations.quote: Two or three days of asking desks to confirm jobs are really closed so we can invoice.
